title: Walk or graze stock on public roads only under authority
what: Walk or graze stock on a public road only under the authority of a permit or other authority under the Biosecurity Act 2015.

sources.title: Local Land Services Act 2013 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person who owns or has charge of stock must ensure that the stock do not walk or graze on a public road

sources.title: Local Land Services Act 2013 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person is not guilty of an offence under this section if the stock are being walked or grazed under the authority of an order, biosecurity direction, permit or biosecurity zone regulation under the Biosecurity Act 2015
